title: Composition of two coordinate restrictions
statement: For real parameters $\delta_1,\delta_2$ and a target restriction $t\in\{\mathrm{free},\mathrm{fix\ }1,\mathrm{fix\ }(-1)\}$, sum over all ordered pairs of coordinate restrictions whose composition is $t$, weighting a pair $(r_1,r_2)$ by the product of its weights at $\delta_1$ and $\delta_2$. This sum equals the weight of $t$ at $\delta_1\delta_2$.
